title: 찬바람 부는 날
예뻐 보이는 법

segments.label: 소개팅 첫인상 코디
en: First impressions? Change them with color — one look for her, one for him
Her: butter-white bouclé coat, deep purple top, black satin skirt, suede boots
Him: black leather jacket, dusty pink knit, cotton beige pants, black loafers
Formula: soft colors near the face, warm neck, one shiny piece only

segments.label: 퍼 '한 점' 코디
en: Skip the full fur coat — add just one fur touch
01 Fur trim on collars & cuffs of leather or denim jackets — men too
02 One pastel fur piece on an all-neutral outfit
03 Easiest start: a fur bag or beanie on a simple coat
04 Short fur jacket: above the waist + tone-on-tone
Sources: Allure Korea, Vogue Korea, Harper's Bazaar

intro_en: Look good on chilly days: 2 first-date outfits + 4 ways to wear fur
